searchText: hey <@&1416139337179074590> ! I had a small request for feature. I'm currently work on setting up LH VC to have parallel streams from multiple BNs. I did tried to use `use_separated_vc` and pass endpoints to other BNs in the network it did not work. am I doing something wrong and can achieve this or it would be a nice feature to have Are you doing this in kurtosis or elsewhere? If it’s kurtosis, can you give us a example it’s not something kurtosis supports out of the box. use separate vc is meant for teku and nimbus that by default have a vc process baked into their beacon
